newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission clears ADM buy of Grace Cocoa.
newsitem.headline: Commission clears ADM buy of Grace Cocoa.

text.p: The European Commission on Friday approved the acquisition by Archer-Daniels-Midland (ADM) of Grace Cocoa Associates' activities.
In a statement, the Commission said the acquisition was cleared because because it would have no appreciable effect on industrial cocoa and industrial chocolate products markets.
U.S. company ADM is engaged in trading, processing and marketing agricultural commodities and products.
Grace Cocoa, which combines all of the cocoa activities of U.S. chemical group WR Grace, is an important supplier of cocoa liquour, butter and pwder as well as industrial chocolate.
The Commission investigates all deals affecting European markets even if the parties involved are not from the EU.
The Commission said that given the fact ADM was not active in the cocoa business, there was no overlap of activity.
